name: aider-assist
description: Assimilates Aider as a bounded, auditable AI pair-programming capability for Ouroboros AgentOS.

commands.name: ask
commands.summary: Ask Aider about selected repository context without editing files.

arguments.name: message
arguments.description: Question or task prompt sent to Aider.

arguments.name: file
arguments.description: Repository file to include as read-only context.

commands.name: edit
commands.summary: Run a bounded Aider edit task and emit diff, touched-file, verification, and handoff evidence.
commands.usage: ooo aider edit --message <goal> --file path... [--test-cmd cmd] [--lint-cmd cmd]

commands.name: fix
commands.summary: Use Aider to repair a failing lint or test command within bounded editable files.

commands.name: architect
commands.summary: Use Aider architect-style planning to produce a read-only plan or bounded implementation handoff.

capabilities.name: ledger
capabilities.reason: Record task inputs, selected context, diffs, verification, and decisions.

capabilities.name: provenance
capabilities.reason: Record Aider version, invocation arguments, model settings, repo ref, and produced artifacts.

capabilities.name: state
capabilities.reason: Persist Aider run/session status for resumable workflows.

capabilities.name: handoff
capabilities.reason: Attach answer, diff, touched files, test output, and next-step guidance.

permissions.reason: Read selected repository files and context.
Apply bounded code edits for write-capable commands and write artifacts.
Invoke the Aider CLI and optional verification commands.
Call configured model-provider APIs through Aider.
Reserved for future web/URL context modes; not used by v0 commands.
